title: Spotify finally lets parents exclude kids’ music from Wrapped and recommendations
snippet: Parents can finally get the kids' music out of Spotify Wrapped and other personalized playlists.

title: New Italian unicorn Exein rides the physical AI wave
snippet: Italian startup Exein has raised a $270 million round of funding led by Headline at a $1.7 billion valuation.

title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
snippet: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing and customer-support tasks.
